name: Checkout Tax Shipping Revalidation
description: Checkout completion must resolve current valid tax and shipping rules for the committed destination and selections.
purpose: Checkout completion must resolve current valid tax and shipping rules for the committed destination and selections.

requirements.description: Checkout completion must resolve current valid tax and shipping rules for the committed destination and selections.
The rule must be evaluated from authoritative server-side state and must not trust browser-calculated or provider-reported state without required validation/reconciliation.

failure.notes: Phase 12 defines the domain error identifier. HTTP mapping and response envelopes are reserved for Phase 18.

relationships.description: This rule constrains commerce.checkout operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.taxConfiguration operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.shippingMethod operations or state.
This rule constrains commerce.shippingRate operations or state.

valid: An operation involving commerce.checkout, commerce.taxConfiguration satisfies the rule before authoritative state is committed.
invalid: An implementation bypasses commerce.rule.checkoutTaxShippingRevalidation and commits a conflicting or unverifiable state.

implementationNotes: Enforce at the server-side commerce domain boundary.
Use canonical Phase 11 schemas as the data model; do not create shadow transaction models.
If provider behavior differs, translate through an adapter and reconcile to canonical NEXT F state.
